proposed_inventory_and_test_plan.methodology: Fixed-coefficient logistic link with assumed coefficients and thresholds. The coefficients are based on explanatory odds-ratio assumptions and the intercept is selected to give a reference scenario PD ~ 8.9%. The logistic model is not statistically fitted from bank data.
assumptions: Coefficients and thresholds are assumed, synthetic labels do not validate real-world performance

Coefficients are based on explanatory odds-ratio assumptions: utilization +10pp -> OR 1.179; DTI +10pp -> OR 1.120; income +EUR10k -> OR 0.960; one late payment -> OR 1.859. The intercept is selected to give a reference scenario (U=0.30, DTI=0.32, income_k=50, late=0) PD ~ 8.9%
The model is not statistically fitted from bank data
limitations: Coefficients and thresholds are assumed, synthetic labels do not validate real-world performance
